settings.label: Brand name
settings.info: Shown in the lowercase wordmark, the footer watermark and wherever copy says {AppName}. The store name in Shopify settings is not used.

settings.label: Rating label
settings.info: Hero pill and footer card. {count} is the live total of reviews and {rating} the average (see Reviews and guarantee); unknown numbers show as [X].

settings.content: Ratings come from your review app (Judge.me, Okendo, Loox, Yotpo, Stamped…) through Shopify's standard product rating fields. Turn on "product ratings / rich snippets" sync in the app.

settings.label: Total reviews (manual)
settings.info: Overrides the app's total, e.g. 124952. Leave blank to use live data.

settings.label: Average rating (manual)
settings.info: e.g. 4.8. Leave blank to use live data.

settings.label: Guarantee line
settings.info: Shown beside Add to cart and Checkout. Separate items with ·. Only promise what your policies honour.

settings.label: Shipping promise
settings.info: Shown above the guarantee on product pages. Add the same text as an announcement in the header bar.

settings.label: Trust badges
settings.info: One per line as icon|Label. Icons: snowflake, heat, couch, wash, feather, moon, sparkle, leaf, shield, truck, check.

settings.label: Savings explanation
settings.default: Compare-at prices reflect the comparable retail value of similar bedding sold at full price. Your savings are the difference between that value and the {AppName} price.

settings.label: Free gift threshold
settings.info: In the shop currency. 0 switches the reward bar off.

settings.label: Discount code shown once the threshold is met
Fallback products
settings.info: Shown until Shopify's product recommendations for the first cart item load, and when the cart is empty. Defaults to all products.

settings.label: Recently viewed fallback
settings.info: Shown to shoppers who have not viewed any products yet.

settings.label: Product
settings.info: Defaults to the product with the handle silk-sleep-mask. Hidden once it is in the cart.

settings.label: Note
settings.default: Taxes, discounts and shipping calculated at checkout.

settings.label: Trust line
settings.info: Under the guarantee line (Theme settings › Reviews and guarantee). Items separated by •.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Start with our most loved pillow, and get {gift} over {threshold}.
settings.info: {gift} = free gift label, {threshold} = free gift threshold (Cart reward).

settings.label: Call-to-action heading
settings.default: Cloud-like comfort is just a click away. Try {AppName} today.

settings.label: Copyright line
settings.default: © 2026 [Somna legal entity name]. All rights reserved.

settings.label: Support e-mail
settings.info: Shown in the footer's Social column.
